question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ -8 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{2}?$
question.worked_solution:
Remember, the order of the vectors in a basis is important.

Notice that 

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ -8 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}={{(\,-8\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{1}}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{b}_{1}}+{{(\,-7\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{2}}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{b}_{2}}
$$

which means that

$$
x=(-8)\cdot {b}_{1}+(-7)\cdot {b}_{2}
$$

and therefore

$$
[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ -7\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, we have that ${x}_{2}=-7.$
